subtitle: Out Manila · Philippine Airlines
overview: Fly Manila to Shanghai on Philippine Airlines and head to the water town of Nanxun, then Hangzhou for West Lake and the Meijiawu tea plantation, and finish in Shanghai at the Bund and Nanjing Road. All four nights are in 5-star hotels, with a private coach and an English-speaking guide. The rate includes two shop visits.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 6–10 2026 to Dec 4–8 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Nanxun Ancient Town: A Jiangnan water town with canals and old mansions, explored with a rowing-boat ride.
placeDesc.West Lake: Hangzhou's famous freshwater lake, a UNESCO World Heritage site; the visit includes a Black Pearl afternoon tea.
placeDesc.Meijiawu Tea Plantation: A tea-growing village near Hangzhou where the tour offers tea tasting and a Hanfu experience.
placeDesc.Hubin Yintai in 77 Mall: A shopping mall beside West Lake in Hangzhou, visited as a city stop.
placeDesc.Belt and Road Silk Factory: A silk factory experience in Hangzhou, a region known for silk.
placeDesc.Shanghai 5D Illusion Interactive Space: An indoor interactive illusion attraction in Shanghai with immersive photo scenes.
placeDesc.Starbucks Reserve Roastery: A large Starbucks Reserve coffee roastery in Shanghai, visited as a sightseeing stop.
placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverside promenade lined with historic buildings, with views across the Huangpu River.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: A landmark TV tower in Pudong with spheres on its frame; the tour makes a photo stop.
